title: Algebra 1 Foundations | Pre-Algebra Review Bundle
description: Review fundamental Pre-Algebra skills at the beginning of the school year before tackling Algebra 1! Includes 5 differentiated riddle worksheet sets and 3 classroom anchor chart posters.

qa.question: What skills are reviewed in this bundle?
qa.answer: Order of operations (GEMS), combining like terms, 1- & 2-step equations, multi-step equations, and absolute value inequalities.

title: GEMS Order of Operations Poster & Anchor Chart
description: A clear visual reference guide replacing traditional PEMDAS with GEMS (Grouping, Exponents, Multiply/Divide, Subtract/Add).
imageAlt: Order of Operations GEMS Poster Preview

qa.question: Why use GEMS instead of PEMDAS?
qa.answer: GEMS prevents the common misconception that multiplication always precedes division and addition always precedes subtraction.
